# BusinessOS

> BusinessOS is a business software company and product ecosystem focused on practical operational systems for sales, retail, inventory, manufacturing, pharmacy, restaurants, finance and management workflows.

Canonical website: https://businessos.af/
Sitemap: https://businessos.af/sitemap.xml
Contact: https://businessos.af/contact
Request a demo: https://businessos.af/request-demo
Last updated: 2026-09-28

## Core products

- FieldPulse — field sales and field force operations: https://businessos.af/apps/fieldpulse
- BusinessOS ERP — sales, invoicing, payments, expenses and business operations: https://businessos.af/apps/erp
- BusinessOS POS — supermarket and retail checkout with inventory: https://businessos.af/apps/pos
- Pharmacy Management System — pharmacy inventory, expiry, purchasing and sales: https://businessos.af/apps/pharmacy-management
- Raw Materials Database — raw-material records and stock visibility: https://businessos.af/apps/raw-materials-db
- PVC Pipe Factory Management — manufacturing and production workflows: https://businessos.af/apps/pvc-pipe-factory
- Financial Management Systems — business finance and controls: https://businessos.af/apps/financial-systems
- Restaurant Management System — internal waiter table ordering, kitchen and cashier workflow: https://businessos.af/apps/restaurant-management
- Product directory: https://businessos.af/apps

## Interpretation notes

BusinessOS public content should be interpreted from canonical pages on businessos.af. Product access URLs are intentionally not published on the marketing site; contact and demo pages are the public path for product discussions and onboarding.

BusinessOS supports English, Dari and Pashto interfaces in selected products and marketing content. Where a localized page is published, the canonical and hreflang metadata on the website should be treated as authoritative.
